title: A polyelectrolyte stabilizer cooperating with sodium silicate to stabilize surplus soils from engineering projects to establish dual-crosslinking flowable stabilized soil
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48072-48082
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04933D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Haiyang Zhang, Dengliang He, Shishan Xue, Shuxin Liu, Mengyong Ran, Yi Liu
A novel strategy was proposed by incorporating as-synthesized anionic polyelectrolytes and sodium silicate, which exhibited outstanding fluidity of 202.33 mm and compressive strength of 6.25 MPa.
